reviews.text: I was so happy to find LUXE after an unplanned rescue. A WONDERFUL place, in EVERY way! Everyone is beyond kind, beyond helpful, will help you in any way they can, make a plan that works, and talk to you about anything. Never pressure, only recommendations. seem to really enjoy doing it too! I was very ill and even had help getting my dog inside! VERY flexible.Comforting. Beautiful place too, truly lovely facility. The doctor is specialized in unique ways, SO talented, really knows her stuff, above and beyond. I cannot possibly say enough! Highly recommend! I hope I stay w them FOREVER!! GO TO LUXE!!!! They will take the best care of you & your fur babies!!!!🩷

The staff and veterinarian were wonderful!  Our dog was nervous as soon as we walked in, but everyone was so calm and patient with her.  They also took health and safety precautions and communicated the treatment plans very clearly.

We’re new to the area, but I think we’ve found our vet!

Brought my 15 year old kitty, Marceline, here due to an emergency on a Sunday. The receptionist was calm, friendly and polite in person and on the phone. She offered my partner and I water or coffee upon our arrival.

This vet office is immaculately clean- our vet tech even offered us a small tour of the facility and not a hair was out of place. I also admire that this business is woman-owned.

All-in-all it was a great experience and they treated Marceline very well. Thanks ladies. <3
Snoopy broke two toes and was transferred from Flagstaff VC. The doctor was excellent and didn’t perform and unnecessary testing or treatments. Pricing was fair and transparent.

Update: July 22, 2026

It is extremely important to give excellent hospitable care no matter what walks in the door!  Sad to report… Following my telephone conversation with Sam, the Office Manager at Luxe.vet, on July 20, 2026, I was disappointed to learn that my request for a refund would not be considered because the services had been performed and there was no finding of malpractice. While I understand that position, my concerns are not based solely on the medical outcome. They are based on the quality of care, communication, professionalism, and overall client experience, all of which fell well below my expectations.

During my visit, I observed staff removing and leaving personal protective equipment on surfaces where dogs and other animal patients were examined. From both a cleanliness and infection control perspective, I found this practice concerning and inconsistent with the professional standards I expected from a veterinary clinic.

I was the only one physically present for Reece's appointment. My husband participated by telephone throughout the visit because we both wanted to understand Reece's condition and treatment plan. As a first time pet owner who had adopted Reece only the day before, I arrived understandably anxious and seeking guidance. Instead of feeling supported, I felt my concerns were minimized. Dr. Jamie Lenberg's demeanor and facial expressions gave me the impression that my questions were viewed as unnecessary rather than an opportunity to educate and reassure
a new pet parent.

Several important questions remained unanswered. After the veterinary technician administered medication, Reece immediately vomited it back up. When I asked what I should do if this happened again at home, particularly with his antibiotics, I was not given clear instructions or practical alternatives. Likewise, after multiple attempts to obtain the parvovirus sample resulted in visible bleeding, I repeatedly asked where the blood was coming from but never received a clear explanation or meaningful reassurance.
Rather than ensuring I fully understood Reece's condition and felt confident in his care, I was encouraged to purchase a $475 concierge package. Given the uncertainty surrounding Reece's health, this recommendation felt premature and insensitive. At that point, I did not know whether he had parvovirus or whether the test results could be relied upon. After leaving the appointment, my husband and I decided to seek evaluation at an emergency veterinary hospital because we lacked confidence in our understanding of his condition and the next steps in his care.
As a pet owner, I sought professional medical care to receive answers, guidance, and reassurance. Instead, I left feeling more confused, unsupported, and concerned than when I arrived. A person may smile or make light conversation simply to ease an uncomfortable situation, and that should never be interpreted as satisfaction with the care received.

My dissatisfaction is not based on the medical outcome alone. It is based on the quality of
communication, professionalism, empathy, and customer service I experienced. For these reasons, I respectfully request either a full refund.  I believe this request is reasonable and justified given the significant shortcomings in the care and support provided during Reece's first veterinary visit.

Original Review Below:

Maurice Burg As a new doggy dad who adopted Reece the day before, I chose Luxe.vet because of the positive reputation and reviews.

Unfortunately, my experience did not reflect the compassionate, educational, and supportive care I expected during a very emotional time.  Dr. Jamie Lenberg’s communication felt cold and disconnected. Medical concerns were discussed without clear explanations, and when I asked questions to better understand Reece’s condition, symptoms, and care plan, I did not receive the reassurance or answers I needed.
Thank you so much for the 5 stars Donna!
Thank you for the 5 star review Mary!
Attentive service, and good vet and vet techs. Luxe was recommended to me by a friend and I wholeheartedly recommend them to others!

Watching Dr Lenberg and staff manage our first puppy visit and an emergency walk-in made me realize what a tough job they have, precisely because they made it look so easy. She patiently sat with us and answered all
our new puppy questions while handling our little man as if his exam was all that was on the schedule. The rest of the staff were equally professional and gentle with our puppy. We look forward to coming back for years to come.

Brought my dog in for a sudden missing blink reflex in one eye. The vet did a chest x-ray and a Valley Fever test. Because the initial blood test was negative, they found nothing else, and immediately referred us to another practice for a costly brain MRI as the "only way" forward.

Thankfully, we got a second opinion first. The second vet immediately recognized it as a textbook case of regional Valley Fever, noting that false-negative titers are incredibly common with neurological symptoms and that an X-ray wasn't even necessary. They simply prescribed an antifungal, explaining that the blinking reflex would return and the blood test would eventually show positive in a couple of months, which is exactly what happened. They correctly treated my puppy without forcing us into an expensive MRI or X-rays. I'm rating 1 star because missing a common regional diagnostic nuance in favor of immediately pushing expensive imaging leaves me questioning either their training or their motives.

Update in response to owner: Please check your system for two separate transactions under my account on December 13, 2025 ($953.70) and December 29, 2025 ($230.00). Missing a common regional nuance (like false-negative titers in neurological Valley Fever cases) and immediately pushing a costly MRI referral is why I left this review. Claiming you have "no record" of a client who spent nearly $1,200 with you just six months ago only further highlights the administrative and clinical disconnect here. Only leaving this review to warn other clients to find another vet who doesn't practice defensive medicine and treats pets empirically. I am not looking for a resolution.

This is where everyone should be taking their FurBabies. Dr.Lenberg is Amazing! I'm so grateful to her and Sam for all the extra care they gave to my Pup. The entire team is compassionate and caring. This clinic is not associated with big corporate backers. They do not have an agenda or a quota. Everything they do is because they sincerely care.

We have taken two of our cats to see the very caring Dr. Lenberg and Dr. Joy and the wonderful tech Arisa twice in the last few months. At each visit our kitties were treated with the utmost compassion and knowledgeable care. Everyone there makes such a wonderful effort with what can be a very stressful visit for  our cats (and us). Their friendly, calm and professional demeanor, outstanding communication and follow-up was really apparent. And the office feels so welcoming. The first time we went it was because our long-standing vet was not open on the weekend for an emergency visit so we decided to give them a try and we were so impressed that we went back with our other cat when she was having issues. Everyone here really goes the extra mile and we are so happy that we found you!
Staff is friendly, helpful and professional!

We had such a great experience at Lux Vet! The clinic is incredibly clean and well-maintained, which immediately made us feel comfortable. The staff is so caring and attentive—they truly take the time to make sure both you and your pet feel at ease. One thing that really stood out was how they followed up afterward to check in, which shows how much they genuinely care. Highly recommend Lux Vet if you’re looking for compassionate, high-quality care!

Dr. Lenberg and all of the staff have taken amazing care of my cat, Mimi. She just celebrated her 18th birthday and they have been an integral part of keeping her healthy in her senior years.

It's clear everyone on the team loves animals and is passionate about what they do. They treat Mimi so kindly (she gets very stressed and scared at the vet) but they are all very gentle and loving with her and I feel comfortable when she's in their care.

The team is very responsive when I call or email with questions and I never feel rushed through appointments. The cute welcome signs in the exam room are a nice touch, too.

I definitely recommend them if you're looking for a vet who will be a partner in your pet's care.
Sam took such good care of my baby girl! The sweetest staff and best doctor. They really care about their patients

We recently started using Luxe for our rescue. So far we have been really pleased with the services and communication has been great! Dr Lenberg is very thorough and all staff professional and kind. Prices are definitely fair especially for the array of services they provide and the fact that they have non traditional hours.

Luxe Vet has been absolutely incredible with my dog, Missy. The entire team went above and beyond with her care and showed so much compassion during a stressful time.  They took the time to explain everything and truly treated her like their own. I’m so grateful for everything they’ve done for us. Highly recommend!!!

It’s a night and day different experience at Luxe Vet! 10/10 recommend. Dr. Lenberg is awesome, and will spend more time with you than any other provider for the same cost as another provider. Thank you:))

Went  here for an urgent care appointment. Our young dog had an eye injury, and we spent hours waiting at a nearby emergency vet in the parking lot. Through an Internet search, I found this Luxe and made an urgent care appointment. The staff was absolutely amazing and the vet was wonderful. They spent so much time with us, we’re so nice to our dog and provided amazing service. Highly recommend.
The veterinarians and support staff here are amazing!  I would highly recommend them!!!

We are so very thankful for finding Luxe to perform a splenectomy on our senior dog. I can't tell you how much we appreciate this awesome clinic. Everyone there really took the time to make us feel comfortable and address any questions or concerns we had before and after his surgery. We really felt like everyone there really cared about our sweet Porter. The little details really made us feel like we made a great decision to take him there and didn't feel like just another number. They also went above and beyond to make it more financially obtainable than the quote we were given from the emergency vet. Our sweet guy loved everyone there and we felt like they really care about you and your beloved pet 🥰 Thank you guys for being awesome. Porter is now home resting and recovering and our hearts are much lighter from worry.
I have recently started taking both of my dogs to Luxe Vet.  They take great care of my babies. I would highly recommend looking into this veterinary clinic if you are looking for something new.

Dr. Lenberg and all of the staff at Luxe Vet I have had the pleasure of working with are wonderful. They consistently go above and beyond to ensure top of the line patient care, while always doing what they can to reduce any fear/anxiety in my dog during his appointment to make it a positive experience for him. He actually loves going to the vet now and seeing his friends over at Luxe Vet.

Attached is a photo of my rock eating Shih Tzu that Dr. Lenberg and the staff took great care of. I highly recommend this clinic for both wellness and urgent care appointments. They are also one of the few clinics in this area open on Sunday which is fantastic. Thank you for everything, Luxe Vet!
Great staff, wound up having to put my little girl to sleep. Staff was compassionate,  understanding and respected my decisions.

Dr. Lenberg and all of the girls that helped me with my Chihuahua with heart problems have been amazing.  This all came about last minute and I was panicking.  They are all very knowledgable and offer a lot to help figure out my dog's diagnosis.  So thankful the rescue group referred me to Luxe Vet!
C. Bridgford

Dr. Lenberg is the best vet I’ve ever been to! Both of my kitties see her, and both are much better off because of it. She does such a thorough exam at every appointment, and all of her staff are so kind and knowledgeable. My senior cat, Sabrina, has kidney disease and has been feeling so much better since starting her treatment at Luxe Vet. My eight-month-old kitten, Willow, has been sick for the last four months and has been to two other vets who just pushed antibiotics to treat the symptoms instead of looking for the root cause. When I brought her to Dr. Lenberg, Willow seemed to be on the brink of death, but Dr. Lenberg was able to figure out what was wrong within the first appointment, while the two other clinics hadn’t been able to do in four months. It’s only been a week, but Willow is a completely different kitten! I owe so much to Dr. Lenberg and her team!

I started coming to Lux-vet this year for my dogs from a referral.   I had an issue with my girls front leg which I a told would require surgery from 2 Vets here in Gilbert. After 1 visit here at Lux-vet Dr Lenberg had taken a sample from her leg discovered the problem and treated it with meds. After about 6 weeks of treatment  my girls leg is back to normal. I live in Gilbert and there are 20 plus vets here within a 5 mile radius of me and I am very Happy traveling 45 min 1 way to come here.

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Dr. Lenberg and the entire veterinary team. When my dog Remington became very sick with Acute Hemorrhagic Diarrhea Syndrome (AHDS) they acted quickly, gently, and with incredible compassion. It was such a scary situation, but Dr. Lenberg took the time to explain every step of the treatment and made sure we knew exactly what was happening and why.

Remington was treated with the utmost care;  even when he wasn’t feeling well, he was comfortable and calm because he truly felt safe with them. The follow-up calls and genuine concern for his recovery showed how much they care about their patients beyond the appointment.

Thanks to Dr. Lenberg’s expertise and kindness, Remington is back to his happy, tail wagging self. I am so grateful for the outstanding care we received and highly recommend Dr. Lenberg to anyone looking for a veterinarian who treats pets like family!

It was my first visit to the office, definitely not my last visit. I was pleasantly surprised by the welcoming and friendly atmosphere. The staff was incredibly helpful and informative, making me feel at ease while getting my puppy’s first shots.
Thank you for the review Anita! We hope sweet Daisy is doing well.

We took our tiny puppy in to start her health journey anew after battling parvo in California. The staff at Luxe was so friendly and warm towards us and our pup. They are incredibly knowledgeable and explained options with reasons for our future care plan. The prices were also affordable! They are our permanent vet now!

Dr. Lenberg is so caring, compassionate and practical. She treats our Mylo like he’s her own. We never feel rushed or pushed into unnecessary appointments, procedures or costs. We are grateful to be in such excellent hands.

Dr. Lenberg and tech Arisa were friendly and welcoming to both me and my kitty, Rico.  They were communicative and answered my many questions regarding the concerns I had and the procedures we did, and thoroughly explained options and pricing.
The lobby and the rooms are very clean and comfortable.
As you can see by the photos Mr. Rico made himself right at home.  😁
Very nice Office and veterinarians thank you for getting us in so fast and the great experience

My boyfriend and I brought in our 9 year old doxie for a new patient exam and had the best experience! The vet tech and Dr. Lenberg were both thorough with their exam and asked us a lot of questions in order to give our dog the best care. We were also given space to ask as many questions as we needed which was nice since our previous vet sort of rushed us out the door. They did a phenomenal job on his nails as well which was refreshing since the last vet we had did so poorly; these ladies truly care! To top it off, we scheduled a dental cleaning for December. I’ve been nervous to get my dog’s teeth cleaned due to not wanting to sedate him but they walked us through every step and assured us he would be handled with the best care. We are so happy to have found a wonderful new vet and are excited to take our Benny somewhere we trust <3
Always excellent care from Dr Lenberg and her team. She takes care of our chihuahuas and our pitbull. I would highly recommend !

I love this vet office and their doctors.  The facility is super clean and smells great.  Unlike other vet offices I've visited in the past. The staff are caring and patient. Oh and I got in super quick, I didn't have to wait days or weeks.
Everything was wonderful here! They were all so sweet to my kitty and made me feel at ease.

So my dog roxxie her one of her legs and could not out pressure down. So I call the first place on Google and LUXE.VET was able to get me in within the hour. Sam was really great she went over everything I told her where my budget was and she help make sure we didn't go over without compromising the care. Roxxie is doing perfect all thanks to LUCE.VET. also was super friendly and gave me and roxxie a tour of the facility

My 16 wk old Cavapoo puppy was injured by our older big dog. Luxe helped immediately and gave her the best TLC care. We are immensely grateful for their support and treatment. Lucy is back to herself after a tramatic 24 hours. I highly recommend their services for your pet and YOU❣️
Awesome Doctor's, friendly staff, we love bringing our dogs here!

We felt very welcomed at Luxe Vet and I was very impressed by the vet tech Sam, who went out of her way to provide a loving and non judgmental visit! Sam also reached out the next day to see how our dog was doing. Really wonderful service provided!
Luxe Vet gave my dog Marvel outstanding service and care at a great price. Thank you to all of the folks at Luxe Vet . Marvel is feeling much better!
Best vet I've been to

Luxe Vet provides exceptional care at very fair prices. The team treats every animal with genuine compassion and has a calm, professional approach to handling pets with anxiety. Our Malinois has terrible anxiety, but they handle it with such grace and care. The Dr’s are extremely knowledgeable take time to answer questions so you don’t feel rushed out of the door. Their bedside manner is excellent, and the facility itself is clean, modern, and beautifully designed.

So grateful for this team! They got my pup in so quickly when she needed care, and treated her with so much love and attention. The staff was kind, attentive, and professional, the girls were so gentle with my pups too. Not to mention the office itself was so clean and welcoming. Highly recommend!

What a wonderful new veterinary practice in town! I brought all three of my dogs in to establish care and was treated like royalty from the minute I walked in the door. The team was so kind and engaging, and the doctor was very attentive and focused on getting to know everything about my dogs. If you’re looking for a practice that is all about the animals while making sure the clients are also well cared for, look no further than LUXE!
All they care about is money!! Don't waste your time!!! Fancy office to cover up terrible service
If you love your pet DO NOT bring it here!! They say they do all these different things but they don't. They just string you along while robbing you blind. They are not kind and they don't care!!!!
I was totally impressed with the personal care the staff extended to us. they treated me and my granddog witht he upmost respect. I would recommend this clinic to anyone.
The service was excellent and the doctors and nurses did a thorough evaluation of say dog and Oliver is doing very well now.
Great experience!
Cannot say enough about the amazing care and compassion. Veterinarians and support staff exceptional . Highest recommendation. Privately owned (not corporate) so care is at another level.

I’m a Veterinary Technician no longer in the clinical setting. Dr. Gulinson and Kenny were both knowledgeable and genuinely care. More importantly I only brought my pet in for an ear infection but Dr. Gulinson gave him a very thorough exam and explained all my options. She cared about my pets overall wellness. Highly recommend! Prices were reasonable to the area and the luxury setting was a plus!

Over my seventy plus years I have seen many vets, Dr. Joy is an excellent vet, kind and caring.  The entire staff are very friendly and nice.  Kenny especially does an a great job to help you understand how to take care of your pet.  I think Luxe Vets is one of the best if not the best place to take your pet.
Very professional & kind staff. Dr Joy was compassionate & informative. She took her time to explain everything. I highly recommend this place!

If I could give ten stars I would!
Dr. Lenberg is a phenomenal veterinarian. She has been caring for my dogs for more than six years. I am so proud of her and the exceptional practice she has opened.
They have the most amazing staff. Knowledgeable, professional, compassionate and caring. Sam is a top notch professional and wonderful person. The facility is complete with state of the art equipment. Not to mention the beautifully designed offices and exam rooms.
They also offer a Concierge service program, which is excellent. The price of services is very fair and competitive. I feel fully supported and comfortable bringing my dog to Luxe.Vet and you will as well.

Jamie and her staff are the best. Exceptionally caring and dedicated. From the first conversation at the front, to the care received from Dr. Lenberg, I was really happy. It's reassuring to have quality vet care. I won't take my pets anywhere else.

Lux.vet is super clean and state of the art.  I love the concierge approach for my dog.  The ability to call an 800 number for advice on off hours is also a great perk for a busy traveler.  Office hours of 8am-8pm is also super compelling.  Dr. Linberg is exceptional and I am excited for my dog's new vet home!

While visiting my brother my dog had an ear issue and we were not able to get to his regular vet (over 3 hours away).  Luxe saw him within an hour of when I called.  They were caring, professional  and thorough and took good care of him.  I would use them again and highly recommend them to anyone in the area.

Took our new puppy Murphy in here after a friend referred me. Everyone is super nice and informative! They really let me know in detail what to expect with my pup and made sure he was up to date on shots. Highly recommend for anyone who loves their animals and wants to take them somewhere where the people actually care about their wellbeing. Thanks again
Great customer service, they understood my concerns, educated me about the process and had great follow up! 5 stars!

I am absolutely thrilled with my experience at this outstanding veterinary office! From the moment we stepped through the doors, I knew we were in good hands. When my cat, Kitty, was struggling with respiratory distress, the staff sprang into action, welcoming us with urgency and compassion. The facility itself is simply breathtaking—bright, modern, and equipped with state-of-the-art technology that reassured me my pet was receiving the best possible care.

Dr. Barns was not only incredibly professional but also radiated warmth and genuine concern for my cat's well-being. Her expertise and caring demeanor instantly put me at ease during a stressful time. The team around her exuded kindness, creating a family-oriented atmosphere that made me feel valued as a pet owner.

What truly impressed me was their commitment to follow-up care. They called me twice the day after our visit to check on my beloved cat, Kitty, which clearly demonstrated their dedication to his health. When I needed to adjust the medication prescription, Dr. Barns swiftly coordinated with the pharmacist, ensuring the process was seamless and free of any complications.

I cannot recommend this veterinary office highly enough; I feel incredibly fortunate to have found such a remarkable place for my pet’s care!

Hyehyun (Cindy and Kitty)

so strong in their care of our loved pets...my pet is carrying an
irritation on his two front paws...they are doing a great job focusing on the cause and solution.  so grateful for their help.

Absolutely the best compassionate care. My puppy swallowed a rock and I was dealing with a death in the family I was really upset having to deal with this. They were so comforting and they did their best to get that rock out of his stomach, they saved the day. Don't hesitate to bring you pet here 5 stars all the way!!

LUXE VET is what every pet owner WISHES they had available for their beloved (non-human) family members. The professional care, concern and love shown by these awesome care givers is truly inspiring. It's almost as if the animals were their very own. We could not have wished for (or imagined) a more state of the art, personalized, concerned and attentive staff and facility. We felt like we were 20 years into the future and had no worries that the absolute BEST CARE POSSIBLE was available and provided to our little angel. We are clients and friends for life. Hands down the best animal clinic anywhere.

I've never experienced this level of care for my dog anywhere else. I greatly appreciated the transparency of showing me where my dog would be cared for and monitored. It made me feel infinitely better given the situation. And not only that, regularly checking in after the procedure to make sure she was recovering well was next level service. Thank you so much Luxe for being so great to my dog. Can't imagine taking her anywhere else.

Dr Lenberg and her team are wonderful! They handled my paraplegic dog with such care and she was very comfortable with them all right from the start. She could feel the good vibe despite the rainstorm we went through on the drive there which typically makes her quite nervous.

They have a well equipped clinic that allows them to handle many procedures right on the spot saving the time and hassle of needing to book elsewhere. The clinic was very clean and pricing was reasonable.

As someone who prefers integrative care, it was refreshing to meet a knowledgeable and open minded vet. I love that we have this wonderful practice in our community! 🤗

LUXE Vet is Amazing all the way around. The staff was so kind and made us feel comfortable all while getting our dog healthy and back to her normal self! I highly recommend this vet for anyone looking for great care and attention for their pet.
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support. Looking forward to seeing you and Toby again at LUXE.VET!

My fiance and I have been bringing our pug in for the last few months and cannot rave enough about the incredible care she’s received from all staff, especially Dr. Lenberg, Dr. Barnes, Patty, and Sam. Staff here truly treat and love your pet like family-our Peanut walks in and leaves still wagging her tail because they truly make it feel like home to her and give her so much love and attention :) This office not only has the most unbelievably kind, thoughtful, attentive, and detail-oriented staff, but they also truly take the time to do a thorough physical exam every time and address any and all questions/concerns without rushing you. They know you and your pet by name and are incredibly warm and personalized in their approach-every staff member has gone above and beyond in their communication and obvious compassion and love for animals. When Peanut needed an urgent splenectomy last week, Dr. Lenberg and Dr. Barnes came in on their day off to ensure she got the surgery as soon as physically possible and charged us half what we were told to expect by other local clinics, while still providing  Peanut an incredibly safe and personalized anesthesia experience. They kept us extremely informed of updates throughout the procedure and recovery and were extremely thorough in their post-op education and follow up visit yesterday. They have been the most thorough, professional, and empathetic team I’ve ever encountered In 27 years of having pets and were unbelievably lucky to have found them, especially given Peanut’s complex medical needs. We’d recommend this practice warmly and without hesitation. Exceptionally convenient location and parking as well very close to the new PV mall redevelopment! If you want your pet to consistently receive the highest possible level of care in a warm, beautiful, meticulously clean environment with staff that truly love the work they do, end your search and just go to Luxe Vet-you’ll be extraordinarily glad you did. Tell them Peanut sent you ;)

What a wonderful experience! We are new to the area and knew we needed to find a vet for our high maintenance Great Dane, Goonie.  He is very anxious about going to the vet so, of course, we were  anxious to find a vet that could handle our big baby! We couldn't be more grateful to have found Luxe. The office is clean and lovely, the staff is so kind and patient. Everyone took their time, never making us feel rushed. Everyone was so patient with Goonie and his tail was actually wagging when we left. Welcome to the area, Luxe!

Awesome and friendly staff.
Very clean, Dr. Joy is so nice & caring!

My 11 1/2 year old peke-a-poo, Emmy, saw Dr. Joy, (who is amazing), yesterday.  First of all, the office is beautiful and the staff who greeted us and took care of us, Patty and Ashley, were amazing.  Emmy had been going to her previous vet(s) since she was a puppy and I was very happy with them.  However, the level of care, compassion, professionalism, etc. at Luxe Vet cannot be beat.  And, I received a follow-up call this morning to check up on Emmy and see how she's doing!  Little things like that mean a lot to me as Emmy's mom.  I cannot say enough wonderful things about Luxe Vet.  They absolutely blew me away!!!!!  I give them a 10 star rating!!
New to the area. Beautiful facility with a great Staff & Doctors.  Love that they are open 7 days a week!

I am excited to see Luxe Vet open! My pooch, Larry 'The Imposter' has been a patient of Dr Lenberg's for the last couple of years and has been well taken care of.  Her passion to give the very best care for her patients is one reason why I trust her with Larry's health.  Larry has multiple physical and health issues but with her knowledge and expertise, Larry has gotten exponentially better.  We recently brought him to Luxe Vet and he and I was excited to see the new place. Exceptionally clean and the Medical Team there is amazing. Big Kudos! Everything from booking an appt to actual care is 5 star!  The time the Vet spends with your pet is not like Banfield or other In & Out type facilities because Luxe Vet is a Concierge Vet service. Not like these 10 min interaction Bulk Vets. Every animal is different and has different needs. I definitely suggest bringing your furry family member here when they need medical attention.

I had a fantastic experience at this beautiful vet clinic in AZ. The staff was compassionate and professional, providing exceptional care for Margarita. The clinic’s warm and welcoming atmosphere made the visit stress-free and reassuring.

Luxe Vet has been a great experience for me. The 5 ☆ stars goes go to all the staff, especially Sam. I have one of the most anxious dogs and some how she knew exactly how to calm her and make her comfortable. Explained everything they were going to do during our visit which i appreciate. Dr. Barnes and Dr. Lenberg were the ones taking care of the procedure and i couldn’t have been more impressed by the confidence and professionalism displayed. they took care of her as if she was their own. i am so grateful that they went above and beyond for what many would consider just an animal.
Thank you so much for your help, kindness, and patience. I will definitely be back and using this for ongoing care.

Bet vet I’ve been to in awhile!
My cat has diabetes and they treated him and his issues very well and are so caring and respectful! 10/10 would recommend to a friend!
So glad to have Luxe Vet care for my pups! Beautiful office. Friendly and thorough staff. I’ll definitely be making them my regular vet. Dr Lenberg was fantastic!
